mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL year-over-year inflation rate exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and decreases in unemployment signal a strong economy with accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction term has a negative coefficient in a regression with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by low unemployment and strong GDP growth, consumer spending momentum drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly employment growth (PAYEMS above 150,000) signals robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when PAYEMS > 150,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below its 12-month moving average indicates a weakening supply chain, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in housing starts and retail sales signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction term has a negative coefficient in a regression with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime with industrial production above 100 and rising for three months, supply chain normalization supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
